title: Grayton Dream | 6BR Gulf-Front on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Grayton Dream is a signature 6BR Gulf-front estate featuring a private pool and elevator. This luxury rental sleeps 20 in Grayton Beach by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: Grayton Dream by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 284 Garfield Street Details: Experience the ultimate Gulf front luxury at Grayton Dream! Welcome to Grayton Dream: a breathtaking, multi-million-dollar Gulf front estate in the heart of coveted Grayton Beach. Just steps from the beach access, this extraordinary home offers unparalleled panoramic views of the sparkling turquoise Gulf from every level. Spanning over 4,500 square feet, this ultra-luxury retreat was designed for large groups of up to 20 guests, offering the perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and coastal sophistication. Each of the ensuite bedrooms provides a private sanctuary, ensuring everyone enjoys both space and serenity. Styled by the renowned Summer House Lifestyle design studio, every detail of Grayton Dream radiates timeless luxury from its bespoke furnishings to its open, airy floor plan and expansive balconies overlooking the Gulf. Whether you’re hosting a family gathering, a celebration, or simply indulging in the beauty of 30A, Grayton Dream delivers an unforgettable beachfront experience where every sunset feels like your own private show. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -Parking Spaces: 6 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Elevator -Private Heated Pool: 15’6” x 13’8” *Pool heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 20 6 Bedrooms / 7.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Two Queen/Queen Bunks with Two Private Baths (Showers) Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Two Twin/Twin Bunks with Private Bath (Shower) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Half Bath Fourth Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 6 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Laundry Room Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
